Page 2.
Rev. M. E. Joachim Casey
at times be on his nerves. Who can doubt that at times, now and then at least, he must be up against delicat cases? Rather continue to pray for him and for all connected with the institution. They all have their difficulties and there is none without their defects. Who is to blame? .... God could have founded His Church and left/under the supervision of angels, that have no human faults and weaknesses. But who can doubt that as it stands today, consisting of and under the supervision of poor sinners -- successors to ignorant fishermen -- that it is more of a "standing miracle" than in any other way think- institution? It seems to me that our task-our privilege-ought to be just to help along in some trifling way. In a way, the big things are really not so important. There is always some one ready to take care of such-even if, like Judas, they make a botch of it. But what a privilege to take care of trifles that only our guardian-angels enjoy and God himself can divinely appreciate! -- sweeping, pulling weeds, picking potato-bugs, etc. etc.
able? Could not the same thing be said of practically every charitable
How trifling! or suffering little mortifications, offering little ejaculatory prayers, dropping a word of sympathy, etc. all trifles. But "trifles make perfection and perfection is never a trifle. Perfection is divine. In God's sight -- who can doubt -- the world itself is made up of trifles ...... If we were but a tenth as appreciative as we ought to be, how happy we would be simply in our creation and the faculties we're endowed with and the divine promises etemal reward!
(unfinished draft)
